ns2:course.label: Intermediate Spanish
ns2:course.description: Continued development of reading, writing and conversational skills. This is considered a third level course for purposes of fulfilling the University General Education Language requirement. Credit is not given for both SPAN 130 and SPAN 103. Prerequisite: SPAN 122 or equivalent placement score.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both SPAN 130 and SPAN 103. Prerequisite: SPAN 122 or equivalent placement score.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class meetings constitute half of the credit hour requirement, the other half is met by on-line, web-based work. Spanish native speakers should enroll in SPAN 125.
